items.details: Keep enough distance to aim an arrow at the bright forehead gem. When Fyrus is stunned, grab a trailing ankle chain, equip the Iron Boots and pull against his movement until he falls. Release the chain and remove the boots so you can reach his head quickly for sword strikes. Repeat the cycle instead of trying to damage his armored body. Unequip the boots whenever you need to evade.

details_i18n.en: Keep enough distance to aim an arrow at the bright forehead gem. When Fyrus is stunned, grab a trailing ankle chain, equip the Iron Boots and pull against his movement until he falls. Release the chain and remove the boots so you can reach his head quickly for sword strikes. Repeat the cycle instead of trying to damage his armored body. Unequip the boots whenever you need to evade.
details_i18n.pt: Mantenha distância suficiente para acertar com uma flecha a joia brilhante na testa. Quando Fyrus ficar atordoado, segure uma corrente presa ao tornozelo, equipe as Iron Boots e puxe contra seu movimento até derrubá-lo. Solte a corrente e retire as botas para alcançar rapidamente a cabeça e golpeá-la. Repita esse ciclo em vez de tentar ferir o corpo protegido. Tire as botas sempre que precisar desviar.

items.details: Match each arena to the tool it recalls. Use the Gale Boomerang in the Forest arena; on the rocking Goron platform, anchor with Iron Boots and remove them to attack during recovery. items.details: Return the throne-room energy ball with sword swings rather than trying to approach immediately. Against the beast, use arrows to stun its forehead until that tactic is countered, then switch to wolf form and meet its charge with the grab prompt; throw it aside and attack the exposed belly. During the mounted phase, keep the enemy targeted so Zelda can land a light arrow, then close in for sword hits. In the final duel, defend, use your learned sword techniques and follow the on-screen clash and finishing prompts.

details_i18n.pt: Rebata a esfera de energia da sala do trono com golpes de espada em vez de tentar se aproximar imediatamente. Na etapa montada, mantenha o inimigo como alvo para Zelda acertar uma flecha de luz e aproxime-se para golpear. No duelo final, defenda-se, use as técnicas aprendidas e siga os comandos de choque de espadas e finalização.
